newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady in limited trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady in limited trade.

text.p: Cotton prices remained steady in limited activity on Thursday, dealers said.
They said supplies were low while demand from spinning mills remained sluggish. Fresh export enquiries for cotton yarn had also slowed down, dealers said.
"Spinning mills are not buying as heavily as they did last month," said Chandulal Thakkar, a leading cotton dealer.

In spot, Bengal-deshi was steady at 1,050/1,080 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was steady at 1,850/1900 rupees per maund. Gujarat Kalyan was quoted at 14,500/15,000 per candy (355.56 kg). Wagad cotton was unchanged at 13,300/13,400 rupes per candy.
